runs.hypothesis: When low-volatility stocks exhibit regime transitions, mean-reversion in their returns follows in the next period.

factors.name: vol_revert_gap
factors.explanation: Computes the gap between upper and lower quantiles of return in low-volatility stocks, then ranks it to capture mean-reversion during regime shifts.

factors.name: vol_revert_slope
factors.explanation: Measures the covariance between returns and volume for low-volatility stocks to detect regime transitions linked to mean-reversion.

factors.name: vol_revert_residual
factors.explanation: Strips time trends from returns of low-volatility stocks and uses residuals to identify mean-reversion during regime transitions.

factors.name: vol_revert_skew
factors.explanation: Captures asymmetry in return distributions of low-volatility stocks to detect regime shifts associated with mean-reversion.

factors.name: vol_revert_diff
factors.explanation: Compares short- and long-term price changes in low-volatility stocks to highlight mean-reversion during regime transitions.

runs.hypothesis: When low-volatility stocks experience regime transitions, their returns reverse in the next period.

factors.name: lowvol_regime_rev
factors.explanation: Computes the rank of the z-score of the top 10% of volume changes over 20 days, across 60 days, exploring order statistics in volume dynamics.

factors.name: vol_trans_reversal
factors.explanation: Calculates the difference between the top and bottom 10% quantiles of returns over 60 days, exploring shape and dispersion in return distribution.

factors.name: regime_shift_vol
factors.explanation: Multiplies the mean of 20-day volume changes over 60 days with the standard deviation of returns, exploring timescale contrast in volatility and returns.

factors.name: lowvol_reversal
factors.explanation: Ranks the difference in correlation between volume and returns over 20 and 60 days, exploring unusual pairing of volume and return dynamics.

factors.name: vol_mad_reversal
factors.explanation: Ranks the ratio of return MAD to 20-day volume change, exploring odd normalisation of volatility and volume metrics.

factors.name: regime_vol_diff
factors.explanation: Computes the difference between the top and bottom volume changes over 5 days within a 20-day window, exploring order statistics in short-term volume shifts.

runs.hypothesis: When low-volatility stocks show increasing dispersion in returns during regime transitions, they tend to underperform in the next period.

factors.name: vol_dispersion_transition
factors.explanation: Measures the gap between top and bottom deciles of returns minus the median absolute deviation, capturing dispersion in low-volatility stocks during regime shifts.

factors.name: volatility_asymmetry
factors.explanation: Compares the asymmetry of price movements (high vs low) relative to return volatility, highlighting regime shifts in low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: volatility_residue
factors.explanation: Captures the residual return after removing the volume trend, focusing on unexplained volatility patterns in low-volatility stocks.

factors.name: regime_gap
factors.explanation: Identifies extreme price movements by ranking the gap between the highest and lowest returns over a 60-day window, highlighting regime transitions.

factors.name: volatility_skew
factors.explanation: Measures the skewness of return distributions in low-volatility stocks, capturing asymmetric regime behavior.
